findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext as Lambda environment variables, exposing long-lived credentials to anyone with read access to the function configuration or Terraform state, and risking leakage via logs or version control.

The Lambda function does not configure a KMS key for environment variable encryption, so sensitive data (including the embedded credentials) is stored using only default encryption without customer-managed key control, and no explicit encryption at rest setting is enforced.
The function uses nodejs12.x, which is an end-of-life/deprecated runtime lacking current security patches, increasing exposure to known vulnerabilities.
